plain_description: Falcon2-11B-VLM gives computers the ability to see and understand images through natural conversation. It can describe what's in a photo, answer visual questions, and engage in image-based dialogue. The bottom line: it's a research-grade AI purpose-built for teams exploring how vision and language work together.
technical_description: Falcon2-11B-VLM is an 11-billion parameter causal decoder-only vision-language model developed by TII. It integrates a CLIP ViT-L/14 vision encoder with a Falcon2-11B language model via a multimodal projector trained on 5,000B+ tokens of RefinedWeb and 1.2M image-text instruction pairs. A dynamic high-resolution encoding mechanism enables fine-grained visual perception. Inference requires PyTorch 2.0 and the transformers library on a CUDA-capable GPU with a minimum of 22.9GB VRAM. Fine-tuning and quantization are supported. The model can be served via HuggingFace Text Generation Inference.
title: Falcon2-11B-VLM
